name: Arcane Blast: deal 11 damage to target champion
notes: Arcane Blast is ARCANE, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ARCANE champion (Lorraine, Arclight Saber) to unlock element access. Its 11-reserve cost needs more fuel than a natural 7-card hand provides (same shortfall pattern as disintegrate-destroy, which needed extra fillers for an 8-reserve cost); 5 extra filler cards are seeded into hand. Unlike smaller-reserve-cost ARCANE cards in this batch, paying all 11 reserve leaves only 1 hand card left -- too little to afford the Lorraine lineage-inherited 'Enlighten' ability, so no fast-action opportunity is offered at all (confirmed via direct probe: sending a stray PASS there instead answers the ability's own target-choice MZCHOOSE with 'PASS', silently declining the 11 damage). Deals 11 damage directly to the chosen target champion (GeneratedMacroCode.php ~20653-20661, CardDQHandlers.php ArcaneBlastTarget).
